notes.title: Minor release.
notes.notes:
Small fixes and possible to remap game controllers. 

So if you keys is wrong, please remap it again. 

Same if your game run in 30fps, and was run 60fps fine, just change it again.  This game does no longer uses eventuelly frameskips, so if the game run to slow (this should not happens on those machines we have today), you can set it to 30fps.

This game was originally designed after 30/60fps and not after systemtimer (unlike my other games did). But its not a issue in a game like its this.

notes.title: Steam Deck update
notes.notes: Now fully playable on Steam Deck!

notes.title: Another bug fix Release today.
notes.notes:
Im have just fixed some Alt-Enter issues as well lower resolutions should also works again. its might have bugged out in some lower resolutions for some users.

This is my last update until im get my ownership for my game back again (excpt if found other important bugs).

So im do try to fix most issues found in the reviews. Positive as well Negative.
